sql: SELECT s, max(t.yes_sub_title) AS sub_ex, max(t.strike_type) AS strike, left(max(m.title),90) AS title, left(max(m.rules_summary),160) AS rules FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)) split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) AS s, market_ticker, yes_sub_title, strike_type FROM paper_trades WHERE split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) IN ('KXNCAAFSPREAD','KXNCAAFTOTAL','KXNCAAFGAME','KXNCAAF1HSPREAD','KXNCAAFTEAMTOTAL','KXNCAAF1HTOTAL','KXNCAAF2HSPREAD','KXNCAAF1QSPREAD','KXNCAAF1H','KXNFLRECYDS','KXNFLFIRSTTD','KXNFLREC','KXNFLTEAMTOTAL','KXNFL1HSPREAD','KXNFLPASSTDS','KXNFL2HSPREAD','KXNFL1H','KXNFL1QTOTAL','KXNFL1QSPREAD','KXNFL3QSPREAD','KXNFL2HTOTAL','KXNFL1HFT','KXNFL1HTEAMTOTAL','KXNFL4QSPREAD','KXNFLWINMARGIN','KXNFLRRYDS') ORDER BY split_part(market_ticker,'-',1), created_at DESC) t LEFT JOIN markets m ON m.ticker=t.market_ticker GROUP BY s ORDER BY s
